title: What Operations Teams Build With Blink: Dashboards, Trackers, and Approval Flows
summary: Operations teams replace Monday.com, Asana, and Airtable with custom tools built in Blink. Real use cases: approval flows, resource trackers, onboarding apps, and dashboards.
body_markdown: Go to[blink.new](https://blink.new/) and type: "Build a vendor approval workflow. Employees can submit purchase requests with: vendor name, amount, description, urgency, and a file attachment. Managers get notified by email and can approve or reject with a comment. Finance sees all approved requests and can mark them as paid. All three roles — employee, manager, finance — should have different views. Show a status dashboard for managers with pending, approved, and rejected counts."
